text: Cultured, rennet-set curd is cooked, soured in its whey until it is ready, then kneaded in hot water until it stretches. The strand is pulled flat, cooled, salted and wound into a ball of twine, which is why Oaxaca cheese pulls apart in strings. The source gives no stretching-water temperature.
